findings.title: Independent latent composition canvases are overwritten together
findings.expected: Choose the declared background destination canvas only, or abstain and request a manual mapping. Preserve independent subject patch sizes.
findings.actual: width binds5.width,62.width,65.width and height binds5.height,62.height,65.height. Requests768x960 replace384x768 subjects and1920x1088 background with the same size. Composite offsets656/1368/1016 and288 remain fixed.
findings.impact: Changing a global canvas parameter silently changes independent composition operands and destroys the authored layout.
findings.independent_confirmation: CompileCorrectness auditor reproduced original and compiled dimensions in audits/r1-compile/probe_results.json.
findings.proposed_fix: Respect independent dimension domains at multi-input composition. A generic explicit port contract may identify destination; otherwise require manual mapping for unequal parallel canvas sources.

findings.title: Active upstream Efficiency LoRA stacks are omitted from controls
findings.expected: Discover active node3 slot1 through Efficient Loader.lora_stack and expose independent weight/toggle. Simple mode effective model and CLIP weight is3.lora_wt_1; count3 and empty slots2/3 remain unchanged.
findings.actual: Both actual import and loras handlers report zero LoRA items. The only group is the loader empty embedded lora_name; the named upstream stack slot is silently absent.
findings.impact: Creators cannot see, change or independently disable an already active LoRA through its automatic controls. Arbitrary JSON Pointer overrides are available and passed4 exact-write tests, but do not replace requested automatic stack controls.
findings.proposed_fix: Traverse model-consuming loader stack data inputs and use structural stack codecs with explicit effective-weight/count/mode contracts. Avoid treating model_str/clip_str as effective in simple mode.
